regimens.dose_text: Transdermal patch: Initial dose 4.6 mg/24 hours patch applied once daily to clean, intact skin. After a minimum of 4 weeks, increase to recommended maintenance dose of 9.5 mg/24 hours. May increase to 13.3 mg/24 hours in severe dementia. Rotate application sites daily (upper/lower back, upper arm, chest); do not apply to same site for 14 days. Transdermal formulation significantly reduces gastrointestinal adverse effects.

regimens.indication: Mild, Moderate, or Severe Alzheimer's Disease Dementia (Transdermal Patch)

refs.quote: EXELON PATCH is indicated for the treatment of dementia of the Alzheimer’s type (AD).
Initial Dose: Initiate treatment with 4.6 mg/24 hours EXELON PATCH.

regimens.dose_text: Apply one 4.6 mg/24h transdermal patch once daily for at least 4 weeks; if well tolerated, increase to 9.5 mg/24h (standard effective maintenance dose). May further titrate to 13.3 mg/24h for severe dementia. Rotate application site daily (upper back, lower back, upper arm, or chest); do not reapply to same site within 14 days.

value.effect: Pharmacodynamic antagonism of anticholinergics and additive cholinergic toxicity with cholinomimetics.
value.management: Concomitant use is not recommended unless deemed clinically necessary.
